description: This file contains the implementation of the FineractEntityAccessWriteService, a service class responsible for managing entity access and entity-to-entity mappings within the Fineract infrastructure. It includes methods for creating, updating, and deleting entity mappings, validation, and exception handling.

classes.name: FineractEntityAccessWriteServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the service handling creation, updating, and deletion of entity access and mappings in Fineract.

methods.name: createEntityAccess

methods.name: addNewEntityAccess
methods.description: Creates a new entity access record linking an entity with a specific access type and a second entity.

methods.name: createEntityToEntityMapping
methods.description: Creates a new mapping between two entities with validation and exception handling.

methods.name: updateEntityToEntityMapping
methods.description: Updates an existing entity-to-entity mapping with validation and change detection.

methods.name: handleDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles data integrity exceptions, throwing user-friendly errors for duplicate mappings or other issues.
